io.reader

Class UpdateWorkbook

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.reader.ReadWorkbook
      • io.reader.UpdateWorkbook
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ExcelReadable, Readable, java.lang.AutoCloseable, java.lang.Iterable<java.lang.String[]>

    public final class UpdateWorkbook
extends ReadWorkbook
    Uses the Apache POI libraries to read an Excel spreadsheet or similar workbook and update its contents. It supports both Binary XLS and XML-based XLSX formats.

    IMPORTANT: Call save() to persist updates back to disk. Once finished, call ReadWorkbook.close() (or use inside a try-with-resources block) to release underlying POI memory buffers and file handles.

    Change log:

    • Trevor Maggs created on 8 November 2021
    • Trevor Maggs modified on 8 October 2026 - Refactored package location to io.reader, modernised exception handling with TabularDataException, fixed font styling state, and decoupled saving from close lifecycle.

    8 November 2021

      • save

        public void save()
          throws TabularDataException
        Writes updated workbook contents to the target destination file using a temporary file before replacing the existing destination file.

        If an error occurs while writing the temporary file or replacing the destination file, the temporary file is removed where possible.

        Throws:
        TabularDataException - if an I/O error occurs while persisting data to disk
